text: Wata yoga ƴettir jawle yoga e mo'on ko aldaa e laawol shari'a: wano wujjugol maa jattugol maa janfagol. Wata on pooɗondire e mayri ka ñaawooɓe ɓen fii no fedde goo ñaamira jawle yimɓe ɓen, jillondiron e bakkaatu on hara hiɗon nganndi wonde Alla Harminii ɗum. Ko bakkondingol e hoore no anndi ko harmi kon ɓuri kaanude, ɓuri muusude lepte.
